title: Customer Retention by Month
scenario: Identify customers who placed orders in both August and September 2019. Return the result as 'customer_id'.
tableSchema: delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE)
hint: Group by customer_id and use HAVING to check for distinct months.
correctQuery: SELECT customer_id FROM delivery WHERE TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') IN ('2019-08', '2019-09') GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM')) = 2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE); INSERT INTO delivery VALUES (1, 1, '2019-08-01', '2019-08-02'), (2, 1, '2019-09-01', '2019-09-02');
